## What changed and why

## Checks against the core engine
- [ ] Non-fear tone: no risk / danger / toxic / unsafe wording in new user-facing text
- [ ] Every new number answers "compared with what?", and uncertainty is shown
- [ ] Local-first: no new network call without a reason, an entry in "What leaves this device", and an off switch
- [ ] Measuring is never punished: logging, scanning or answering more cannot lower a score
- [ ] Biggest risks first: rankings still put Tier A sources (radon, smoke, lead, PM2.5) ahead of minor ones
- [ ] Calm by design: no streaks, XP, leaderboards, loss-framed messages, or reminders that are on by default
- [ ] Claims: education and process language only; no disease names in outputs, no outcome promises
- [ ] Citations resolved live (PubMed, PubChem, CompTox), never typed from memory
- [ ] `npm run sim` run after engine, scoring or advice changes; `npm run tz` after date changes
